results.title: [B-AG+U-UP] key_state_ecc_q 更新时遗漏 key_state_q 数据回写，导致密钥状态 ECC 与数据失配。
results.analysis_reason: The finding's original wording frames this as a missing guarantee about ECC concatenation/order, but the concrete RTL defect is stronger and directly visible. In the non-reset path, the assignment updates only `key_state_ecc_q[i][j][k]` from `prim_secded_inv_72_64_enc(key_state_ecc_words_d[i][j][k])`; it no longer assigns the encoded data bits back into `key_state_q[i][j][k]`. The decoder later checks `{key_state_ecc_q[i][j][k], key_state_q[i][j][k]}`. Therefore, after any non-zero key-state update, the ECC bits correspond to `key_state_d` while the stored data remains stale, causing false `ecc_errs` / `FaultKeyEcc` behavior and preventing the internal key state from actually updating correctly.
results.trigger_condition: Any normal key-state update where `key_state_d` differs from the stale `key_state_q`, especially a non-zero CDI/root-key-derived state update after reset.
results.security_impact: Key manager state integrity can be corrupted by construction: ECC check logic can report faults for correctly generated new key material, while the actual stored key state fails to advance. This can break key derivation/lifecycle progression and cause spurious fatal integrity handling.

results.title: ecc_errs 路径会因 key_state_ecc_q 与 key_state_q 不一致而错误反映密钥状态完整性。
results.analysis_reason: This is confirmed as the same root cause as F-0002, not as the original speculative claim about primitive concatenation semantics. The RTL decodes `{key_state_ecc_q, key_state_q}` in the ECC loop, but the preceding key-state register block updates only `key_state_ecc_q` and leaves `key_state_q` stale after reset. As a result, `ecc_errs[i][j][k] = |errs` can assert due to an internally introduced mismatch between ECC and data, so the integrity monitor no longer reflects the real integrity of the intended key-state value.
results.trigger_condition: A key-state update occurs, then the generated ECC checker decodes the newly written ECC bits concatenated with stale `key_state_q` data bits.
results.security_impact: The fatal key-state ECC monitor can be driven by design-induced stale-data mismatch rather than real memory corruption, making key manager integrity/error behavior unreliable.

results.title: invalid_stage_sel_o && state_q == StCtrlInvalid 时绕过 entropy mask，直接输出 key_state_q 原始密钥材料。
results.analysis_reason: This bug was not listed as an original finding, but source comparison shows it is a real injected defect. The reference implementation outputs `{EntropyRounds{entropy_i[i]}}` whenever `invalid_stage_sel_o` is true, preventing key state from reaching the outside world under an invalid stage selection. The current RTL adds a special branch: when `invalid_stage_sel_o && state_q == StCtrlInvalid`, it assigns `key_o.key[i] = key_state_q[cdi_sel_o][i]`, explicitly bypassing the entropy masking fallback. This contradicts the surrounding comment that disabled input-data selection should not expose key state. A witness is recommended to prove external observability because the F-0002/F-0004 key-state update bug may leave `key_state_q` stale or zero in common flows.
results.trigger_condition: `stage_sel_o` is outside {Creator, OwnerInt, Owner} while `state_q == StCtrlInvalid`; then `key_o.key[i]` is driven from `key_state_q[cdi_sel_o][i]` instead of entropy mask.
results.security_impact: A fault or invalid-stage condition in the invalid control state can expose raw internal key state on the sideload key output path rather than fail-closed masking it.
